name: nitro-xml
description: Nitro XML: Rust + WebAssembly port of the read/view path of ChristopherVR/ooxml (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), rendered fully in the browser

paragraphs: A Rust → WebAssembly engine that views and edits Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) and PowerPoint (.pptx) files entirely in the browser. Bytes never leave the page. Nitro XML is a port of ChristopherVR/ooxml (Apache-2.0), and its goal is to be the fastest, most efficient, highest-quality OOXML renderer and editor available, beating the original TypeScript engine on every format, at every file size.
Status: planning, Stage 0 not started. No engine code exists yet.
features: 📐 Product spec and gates: docs/PRODUCTSPEC.md (source of every parity, perf, bundle, accessibility and editor gate)
🗂️ Board: (view Ready now for claimable work)
